complete_examples.text: Due to the increase of the reinforcement in the beam sections for resisting a progressive collapse load, it makes the design requirements of “strong-column-weak-beam” to be difficult.

However, if a building structure with relatively seismic-design is designed on this basis, it is necessary to increase the number of reinforcements in the RC columns to meet the requirements of “strong-column-weak-beam”.
